findings.summary: Checked-in synthetic Source artifacts retain exact SHA-256 bindings, and every supporting EvidenceLink reproducibly resolves its unique locator to the revision's source-native raw expression and atomic Claim statement.

Full-package adversarial mutations changing spatial refinement valid-time inclusivity, qualifiers, calendar/normalization state or alternatives are now rejected as temporal-envelope changes, while a revision-local basis_claim_refs addition remains accepted as intended.
The validator still enforces exactly one series per atomic subject_ref/target_key pair, target-key/dimension compatibility and dimension-appropriate revision value families.

Valid time and record time remain distinct; deterministic replay, correction, unresolved alternatives, withdrawal, separate ecological world states, fuzzy ranges and geometry-null unknown routes preserve the intended semantic scenarios.

The documented intake/promotion and minimum-fidelity stop paths remain coherent, while Gate D, public runtime, empty Airtable historical-write authority, project_state.json and the frozen #329/#330/Gate C packages remain unchanged.

Temporal refinement still validates only its primary start/end bounds. Controlled full-package mutations with recomputed ledger and semantic locks were accepted when revision-leo-time-refined changed from proleptic_gregorian/normalized to source_native_unresolved/unresolved, and when it added a 1600-01-01 alternative outside the predecessor's August 1502 possible set. This violates the contract's same-calendar profile and full possible-set subset requirements and leaves accepted #330 alternative semantics fail-open.
